A place to learn, grow and build character

Located in New Lepa, Kasrawad, in Khargone district of Madhya Pradesh, Shri Gurukul Academy provides education for Classes 1–10. This website brings together information about the academy, learning stages, school updates and admission enquiries. Families can contact the school office for current academic details, class availability, facilities and policies.
A strong foundation for every learner
Learning, good habits and a close partnership between school and family help children move forward.
Every learner deserves guidance and encouragement.

We aim to make school information clear and accessible, and to support open communication between families and the academy. The school office can answer questions about current programmes, expectations and admission steps.

Privacy principles
How the academy uses enquiry details and how families can ask questions about their information.
Your information matters

The contact and admission enquiry forms may ask for a parent or guardian name, phone number, email address, class of interest and message. The school uses these details to respond to enquiries and coordinate follow-up. Do not submit Aadhaar numbers, financial information, medical records or other sensitive documents through a general enquiry form. For questions about the handling or deletion of an enquiry, contact the school office.

previous.title: Use of submitted information
previous.description: Information submitted through a form is used to respond to the question and manage follow-up. Depending on the services enabled by the school, enquiry details may also be routed to its designated email or follow-up spreadsheet.

previous.title: Access and retention
previous.description: Enquiry records are available through password-protected administration tools. The school should limit access to authorised staff and apply its approved retention and deletion policy.
